How to check the tone of an email with AI before you send it

We've all written the "as I said in my last 2 emails" email. Before you send it, ask AI how it sounds to the person reading it.

Copy this:

"Read this email as the person receiving it. How does it sound, in one line? Then rewrite it to stay firm but friendly. Keep it short. Email: [PASTE YOUR DRAFT]"

On my example, the one-line read was "irritated and a bit accusing." The rewrite still asked for payment today, but left room for the client to explain.

Use it when you're annoyed, when it's about money, or when it's a client you can't afford to upset. Remove account numbers before pasting.

Send this to someone who still fires off emails while annoyed. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
